with stage_changes as (

    select
        stg_pipedrive_deal_changes.deal_id,
        stg_pipedrive_deal_changes.new_value::int as stage_id,
        stg_pipedrive_stages.stage_name,
        stg_pipedrive_deal_changes.stage_entered_at::timestamp
    from "postgres"."public_pipedrive_analytics"."stg_pipedrive_deal_changes" stg_pipedrive_deal_changes
    left join "postgres"."public_pipedrive_analytics"."stg_pipedrive_stages" stg_pipedrive_stages
        on stg_pipedrive_deal_changes.new_value::int = stg_pipedrive_stages.stage_id
    where stg_pipedrive_deal_changes.changed_field_key = 'stage_id'

),

final as (
    select
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(deal_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(stage_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(stage_entered_at as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as deal_stage_event_id,
        deal_id,
        stage_id,
        stage_name,
        stage_entered_at,
        coalesce(
            lead(stage_entered_at) over (
                partition by deal_id
                order by stage_entered_at asc
            ),
            timestamp '9999-12-31'
        ) as stage_exited_at
    from stage_changes
)

group by deal_stage_event_id

with activities as (
  select
    deal_id,
    stg_pipedrive_activity_types.activity_type_name,
    is_done,
    due_to_at
  from "postgres"."public_pipedrive_analytics"."stg_pipedrive_activity" as stg_pipedrive_activity
  left join "postgres"."public_pipedrive_analytics"."stg_pipedrive_activity_types" as stg_pipedrive_activity_types on stg_pipedrive_activity_types.activity_type = stg_pipedrive_activity.task_type
  where is_done = true
    and activity_type_name in ('Sales Call 1', 'Sales Call 2')
),
stage_activities as (
    select
        int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.deal_id,
        int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.stage_name,
        activities.activity_type_name,

        -- Step 2.1: first completed call while in "Qualified lead"
        min(activities.due_to_at) filter (
            where int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.stage_name = 'Qualified lead'
              and activities.activity_type_name = 'Sales Call 1'
              and activities.due_to_at >= int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.stage_entered_at
              and activities.due_to_at <  int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.stage_exited_at
        ) as sales_call_1_at,

        -- Step 3.1: first completed call while in "Needs Assessment"
        min(activities.due_to_at) filter (
            where int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.stage_name = 'Needs Assessment'
              and activities.activity_type_name = 'Sales Call 2'
              and activities.due_to_at >= int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.stage_entered_at
              and activities.due_to_at <  int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.stage_exited_at
        ) as sales_call_2_at

    from "postgres"."public_pipedrive_analytics"."int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes" int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes
    left join activities on activities.deal_id = int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes.deal_id
    group by 1,2,3
),
final as (
    select deal_id, 
          stage_name,
          activity_type_name,
          sales_call_1_at as first_activity_executed_at
    from stage_activities
    where sales_call_1_at is not null

    union all

    select deal_id, 
          stage_name,
          activity_type_name,
          sales_call_2_at as first_activity_executed_at
    from stage_activities
    where sales_call_2_at is not null
)
select 
      md5(cast(coalesce(cast(deal_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(stage_name as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(activity_type_name as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as deal_stage_activity_event_id,
      deal_id, 
      stage_name,
      activity_type_name,
      first_activity_executed_at
from final

with stage_events as (

    select
        deal_id,
        stage_entered_at as event_time,
        case
            when stage_name = 'Lead Generation'
                then 'Step 1: Lead Generation'
            when stage_name = 'Qualified lead'
                then 'Step 2: Qualified Lead'
            when stage_name = 'Needs Assessment'
                then 'Step 3: Needs Assessment'
            when stage_name = 'Proposal/Quote Preparation'
                then 'Step 4: Proposal/Quote Preparation'
            when stage_name = 'Negotiation'
                then 'Step 5: Negotiation'
            when stage_name = 'Closing'
                then 'Step 6: Closing'
            when stage_name = 'Implementation/Onboarding'
                then 'Step 7: Implementation/Onboarding'
            when stage_name = 'Follow-up/Customer Success'
                then 'Step 8: Follow-up/Customer Success'
            when stage_name = 'Renewal/Expansion'
                then 'Step 9: Renewal/Expansion'
            else 'Unknown'
        end as funnel_step
    from "postgres"."public_pipedrive_analytics"."int_pipedrive_deal_stage_changes"

),

activity_events as (

    select
        deal_id,
        first_activity_executed_at as event_time,
        case
            when stage_name = 'Qualified lead' and activity_type_name = 'Sales Call 1'
                then 'Step 2.1: Sales Call 1'
            when stage_name = 'Needs Assessment' and activity_type_name = 'Sales Call 2'
                then 'Step 3.1: Sales Call 2'
            else 'Unknown'
        end as funnel_step
    from "postgres"."public_pipedrive_analytics"."int_pipedrive_deal_activity_changes"

),

funnel_events as (

    select * from stage_events
    union all
    select * from activity_events

)

select
    date_trunc('month', event_time)::date as month,
    'deals_by_funnel_step' as kpi_name,
    funnel_step,
    count(distinct deal_id)::bigint as deals_count
from funnel_events
where funnel_step <> 'Unknown'
group by 1, 2, 3
order by month desc, funnel_step

with all_values as (
